text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahaha! No way! You're messing
with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Nishino Flower looking like she
wants to
speak to Tosen Jordan.
Unfortunately, the latter
is deep in
conversation with a friend.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Am not! Get this, Nakayama and Prez
threw
cheesy puns at each other for ten
whole minutes!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Wish I could've been there!
Wait—tell
me you recorded it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm? ...Aww, sorry, I gotta dash.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, was Flower here just now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, sounds like I screwed up...
choice_data_list: ああ。君を待っているようだった
うん。貴方を待っているようだった
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. It looked like they were waiting for you.
Yeah. It really felt like they were waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I notice a key chain lying at
my feet.
There's a small plushie hanging
from it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's gotta be Flower's.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Dunno where I'd find her, so I
guess I'll
give it to Bourbon. They're
roomies and all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Bourbon. We picked up something
of
Flower's. Mind passing it along?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged. I shall retain it for
safekeeping.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I didn't take you for a fan of
those sorts
of mags.
choice_data_list_en: Looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is only for investigative purposes. I
purchased
several after seeing Flower
brooding over them
each night.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Something's got her bothered?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Which ones was she reading?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My own interest piqued, I flip through a
few
magazines. Which of these articles
has Nishino
Flower most likely read?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
DIY... Commencing relevant keyword
search.
Article match found: "How to
Build a Resin
Table!"
choice_data_list: イメチェン☆着回しオトナコーデ

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What? Since when is she building a
table?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing her recent behavior, we may

extrapolate that she wants a table to
place by the
flower bed. She must be
deliberating over its
construction.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah... doubt that. Does my look
scream "DIY"
to you?
choice_data_list: さっきは君にその相談に来たのかも
さっきは貴方にその相談に来たのかも
choice_data_list_en: Maybe she came by earlier to consult you about that.
Maybe she came by earlier to consult you about that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But Flower was muttering about lacquer,
polish,
and UV light while reading. This
is the only DIY
article that matches all
terms.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's likely that she was studying the
process of
coloring the wood with
lacquer before hardening
it with UV
light and applying polish.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh... You sure she wasn't reading about
nails?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Nails." Cross-checking database for
related
keywords...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stop, stop! You don't gotta
bother—it's
obviously nail-related! I
mean, tables? Like,
what?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! I bet she wanted to ask me
about her
wardrobe earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Inconsistency discovered. I heard Flower
mutter
several terms while reading
magazines, but none
are in this article.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Expanding the definitions leads to a
weak match
with a shoe care article, but
that seems unlikely.
Are you certain she
is concerned about her attire?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What kinda stuff was she saying?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have records of her saying the words
"lacquer,"
"polish," and "UV light."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's gotta be about nails.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Nails." Cross-checking database for
related
keywords...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stop, stop! You don't gotta
bother—it's
obviously nail-related! Like,
when did shoes even
come into this?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So the terms "lacquer," "polish," and "UV
light"
also fall under the category of
nails? It seems I
must update my
database.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing the sweets competition got
her
interested. Think she wanted my
help or
something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Meh, whatevs. Bourbon, gimme your
hand. I'll do
your nails.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: For what reason is that necessary?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, y'know, since Flower seems
interested.
Don'tcha think it'd be a good
convo starter?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're her roomie and all, so it'd be easy
for her
to bring it up with you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reasoning acknowledged. I will gladly
comply
with your order.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm short on time, so I'll only paint your
index
finger. But I'll make it crazy cute!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Kay, we're done! It's all you now,
Bourbon! Kill it!
